descriptions.d25c_orbit_update_800d6e14: Add dt times the rate of handle +76 to the angle, wrap it to 0..2pi, set +4 and +12 from sine and cosine times the radius plus the centre. For each height +8 and +20: take the larger of itself and the handle +92 value plus 20, then blend 0.9 of the old height with 0.1 of that value.
